dedupe_keys.name: ember yearly electricity data generation capacity emissions imports and demand for over 200 geographies

description: Ember publishes yearly electricity data on generation, capacity, emissions, imports and demand for more than 200 geographies. The data are compiled from multi-country datasets such as EIA, Eurostat, BP and the UN, and from national sources such as the National Bureau of Statistics for China, and are updated twice a month, in the first and third weeks. Since July 2026 the download has one row per area, period and electricity source, with fuels, aggregates, demand and net imports as sources, a flag for aggregates (clean, fossil, renewables, total generation) and metric columns for generation in TWh, share of generation, emissions in MtCO2e, share of emissions, emissions intensity by source, capacity in GW and year-on-year changes, plus EU and OECD membership flags. Global and Europe-only CSV files are available for free download, the data feed the Electricity Data Explorer, last updated 15 September 2026, and an API with a free key serves yearly and monthly data. Ember states that all its content is released under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global. Caveats: figures are national aggregates that are amended as sources change, and the format changed in July 2026. Simulation uses are national generation mix, capacity and demand baselines for energy system models and scenario calibration. Related records: data-ember-europe-electricity-interconnection covers cross-border links.
